name: La Pulga Signature Hoodie
description: Heavyweight loopback fleece hoodie with premium embroidery and contemporary football silhouette.
longDescription: Crafted from 500gsm custom-milled loopback fleece. Features relaxed dropped shoulders, deep double-layer hood, heavy ribbing at cuffs and hem, and tonal Triple Z crest. Signature football-inspired back embroidery and authentic gold badge details.

name: Portugal Heritage Hoodie
description: Deep crimson and forest green block construction with metallic gold crest.
